meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'nobody', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'винять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'blame'.

meanings.note: Locative / directional adverb. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'сюда').

examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.
